blocks.text: A child with hearing loss should be detected and intervention started immediately after delivery. New born hearing screening is done using an otoacoustic emission machine. Otosclerosis is a bony overgrowth that involves the footplate of the stapes. As the overgrowth develops, the stapes can no longer function as a piston, it becomes fixated. Conduction gradually becomes worse until a maximal conductive hearing loss of 60 dB is reached.
